description: This line plot illustrates the BLEU score as a function of average lagging (AL) for three different methods: Consistency-CE, Inconsistency-CE, and Inconsistency-CE-MP. The x-axis, labeled "Average Lagging (AL)", is linear and spans from 0 to 8, with tick marks at integer intervals. The y-axis, labeled "BLEU", is also linear and ranges from 20 to 30, with tick marks at 2-unit intervals. The plot contains three distinct lines: the "Consistency-CE" method is represented by a light purple line with circular markers that starts at a BLEU score of 20 when AL is 0 and increases to approximately 29.5 at AL=8; the "Inconsistency-CE" method is shown as a dark purple line with square markers, beginning at a BLEU score of 22 at AL=0 and rising to approximately 29.8 at AL=8; and the "Inconsistency-CE-MP" method is depicted by a blue line with square markers, starting at a BLEU score of 22 at AL=0 and increasing to approximately 29.5 at AL=8. All three lines show an overall increasing trend as AL increases, with the "Inconsistency-CE" line consistently achieving the highest BLEU scores across the entire range of AL values.
